Mutual Funds See Continued Investor Interest Amidst Volatility

Investors are maintaining their investments in mutual funds despite market volatility, according to coverage from centrist outlets. They are increasingly comfortable delegating decisions on market capitalization allocation to fund managers. There is also a growing preference for "one-stop asset allocation" solutions like Mutual Fund Advisors (MAFs). The coverage also explores which type of mutual fund - large cap, mid cap, or small cap - investors should choose for potentially better returns.
